# T-1: Add agent workdir option

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Introduce --agent-work-dir for flow run commands and route it into container path construction before Agent and Logger are initialized.

## Acceptance Criteria
- --agent-work-dir overrides config.agent.workDir for the current flow run invocation.
- SDD_FORGE_WORK_DIR no longer changes resolveWorkDir behavior.
- Help and argument validation accept the option for flow run commands.

## Implementation Notes
Update early argv scanning in src/sdd-forge.js, work directory resolution in src/lib/config.js and src/lib/container.js, and flow run option declarations.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests for resolveWorkDir, initContainer override behavior, and unknown-option handling.
